name: Cali Blaze Donut Blunt | Bubblegum
description:
Straight-up bubblegum. Pink, sweet, and unapologetically candy-flavored. The indica profile keeps the high balanced — social and upbeat without racing thoughts. Nostalgia hits as hard as the THC.
Key terpenes: Limonene, Myrcene, Caryophyllene

The 1.2g Live Resin Donut. A kief-coated donut blunt with a premium glass tip, wrapped in natural hemp. Infused with live resin and rolled in kief. 

* Glass tip: Smooth, clean draw every time.
* Live resin infused: Full-spectrum concentrate injected into premium flower.
* Hemp Wrap: Natural hemp for a slow, even burn.
